svg.text: FORECAST SKILL · HELD-OUT PATCHES · BOTH ECOSYSTEMS
Per-band R² — one architecture worked, three collapsed
Diverging scale clipped to ±1. Cells beyond −1 are off-scale and hatched, with the true value printed. 347,677,067 optical pixels · 44,348,305 SAR.
Validation loss ranked these within 7% of each other. R² did not — loss alone is not a model-selection signal on this task.
